claims: The 98th Academy Awards were held in March 2026.
"Sinners" received 16 nominations at the 98th Academy Awards.
"Sinners" broke the record for most nominations (16) by a single film at the 98th Academy Awards.
"Bugonia" was a Best Picture contender at the 98th Academy Awards.
"Frankenstein" was a Best Picture contender at the 98th Academy Awards.
"Hamnet" was a Best Picture contender at the 98th Academy Awards.
Michael B. Jordan received an acting nod at the 98th Academy Awards.
Jessie Buckley received an acting nod at the 98th Academy Awards.
Timothée Chalamet received an acting nod at the 98th Academy Awards.
"One Battle After Another" won Best Picture at the 98th Academy Awards.
Paul Thomas Anderson won Best Director for "One Battle After Another" at the 98th Academy Awards.
Michael B. Jordan won Best Actor for "Sinners" at the 98th Academy Awards.
Jessie Buckley won Best Actress for "Hamnet" at the 98th Academy Awards.
Sean Penn won Best Supporting Actor for "One Battle After Another" at the 98th Academy Awards.
Amy Madigan won Best Supporting Actress for "Weapons" at the 98th Academy Awards.
"Sinners" won Best Original Screenplay at the 98th Academy Awards.
Ryan Coogler wrote "Sinners".
"One Battle After Another" won Best Adapted Screenplay at the 98th Academy Awards.
Paul Thomas Anderson wrote "One Battle After Another".
"KPop Demon Hunters" won Best Animated Feature at the 98th Academy Awards.
"Frankenstein" received multiple nominations at the 98th Academy Awards.
"Sentimental Value" received multiple nominations at the 98th Academy Awards.
"Marty Supreme" received multiple nominations at the 98th Academy Awards.
The 98th Academy Awards ceremony was hosted by Conan O'Brien.
